summary: BURNOUT is an experimental series about the bullshit lies we tell ourselves, spanning 3 parts and 19 chapters, complemented by videos, author's notes and behind-the-scenes content by George Kary. It was born out of a passion for exploring multi-disciplinary and cross-functional projects, and, of course, a love of storytelling.
creator: George Kary
